title: CostChoose
description: For each BOQ line, which of the supplied cost candidates (an accepted vendor quote line, a cost-library rate, a historical median) describes the same scope, with a score, a rationale and a selection. The model may only refer to candidates it was given, by ref. It never outputs a rate, a quantity or an action: the rate always comes from the chosen candidate's stored value. Every choice is a proposal that an estimator accepts or overrides.

id.description: The id of the BOQ line, copied exactly from the input.

ranked.description: Every supplied candidate for this line, best scope match first.

ref.description: The candidate ref exactly as supplied.

score.description: How well this candidate's scope matches the BOQ line (1 = certainly the same work, size, material and inclusions).

selected.description: True for at most ONE candidate per line: the one to propose. False if none is suitable.

rationale.description: One or two sentences: why this matches or not (size, material, supply-only vs supply-and-lay, inclusions, unit).

overall.description: One sentence for the whole line, for example why no candidate is suitable.
